tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Discover categories with dated status and fixture flags. Fixtures are synthetic, never real evidence.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Canonical evidence for a category. Cite observed_at, uncertainty and limits; never the best tool. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is not a ranking.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Canonical result bundle or explicit PRE_REGISTERED state. Unknown cost is null / UNKNOWN.

tools.name: explain_limits
tools.description: Limits, freshness, conflicts and answer rule of a category or run. Read before citing evidence.

tools.name: get_auto_tournament
tools.description: Automatic attempts, including failures: current private-store state when configured, otherwise a published snapshot. No execution is triggered.

tools.name: submit_need
tools.description: Log an advisory need.v1 request. Do not include personal or secret data. Returns need-id; persistence is partial until private ingestion and publication.

tools.name: request_tournament
tools.description: Request a tournament using need.v1. Advisory only; never starts a run or spends. Follow the returned id with get_need.

tools.name: get_need
tools.description: Follow need-id in current private-store state when configured, otherwise the published snapshot. Unknown or unavailable means partial, not refused.

tools.name: decide
tools.description: Read-only decision.v1 for one category and a declared context: constraint applicability first, then EVIDENCE or ABSTAIN with a stable reason_code (answer_rule.v3). An abstention removes the verdict only; evidence, reservations and gaps stay. Never a rank on overlapping intervals. Replay and attestat

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_need" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Log an advisory need.v1 request. Do not include personal or secret data. Returns need-id; persistence is partial until private ingestion and publication.
